title: EmailSubmission/set onSuccess* acts on submissions the call never touched
description: submission.rs:471-508 builds the onSuccess map from every literal id in onSuccessDestroyEmail/UpdateEmail and only removes notUpdated/notDestroyed ones. {"onSuccessDestroyEmail":[S]} with no create/update/destroy destroys S's Email. RFC 8621 §7.5 "if the create/update/destroy succeeds". (probe-confirmed) (mail-server review 2026-11-19)
